profile.summary: Techie with a passion for the arts.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend software engineer on the YouTube Living Room (YTLR) team, specializing on the YouTube app that lives on smart TVs, gaming consoles, and smart screens.

Current: YTLR Search team (Feb 2024 - present)
• Built a custom multi-cluster search results row that surfaces when searching for a prominent YT channel.
• Generate video recommendations based on the user's searches before the user enters a query.
• Collaborate across YouTube engineering teams, including YouTube Primetime, Music, and Shows.

Previous: YTLR Discovery team (July 2018 - Feb 2024)
• Worked on the backend systems that deliver personalized video recommendations across the YTLR app.
    - Built the YTLR News tab.
    - Modernized recs on the YTRL Gaming tab.
    - Delivered on time-sensitive projects involving external partners, including the MLB and NFL.
    - Improved recs on the Home and Music tabs.
• Built and supported video recommendation APIs that interface with external clients such as Android TV, Google Assistant, Samsung, and more.
• Built the YouTube API integrations used on Google TV's homepage, including:
    - NFL Sunday Ticket
    - Top picks for you
    - Continue watching
    - YT-specific rows (e.g. "Recommended", "Trending", etc.)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-stack engineer for the Cisco Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW) team with a focus on API backend work

• Developed end-to-end code for the Firepower Device Manager (FDM), Cisco’s web-based local firewall manager using the Spring Java framework
• Wrote automation code using Cisco’s Python testing framework to test all new code checked into the product
• Previously worked as a full-stack engineer for the Cisco Firepower Management Center (FMC), as well as a low-level platform developer for the Cisco Firepower firewall products and Snort, Cisco’s open-source network intrusion detection system (NIDS)

Info on each of the products mentioned:
• Firepower Device Manager (FDM) - https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/products/security/security-management/firepower-device-manager.html
• Firepower Management Center (FMC) -
http://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/products/security/firesight-management-center/index.html
• Firepower next-gen firewalls -
http://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/products/security/firewalls/index.html
• Snort -
https://snort.org/

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Teaching Assistant (TA) for EEL3834 Programming for Electrical and Computer Engineers in C++

• Lectured 60 students on object-oriented programming and other fundamentals
• Held office hours several times a week for students to receive assistance
• Administered and graded student coursework

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed full-stack internal web tools using the Django Python web framework that analyzed testing data and provided the quality engineers useful metrics and suggestions to improve their testing coverage
• Pushed code into production on a daily basis for users ranging up to the Security VPs of Engineering
• Worked with a team of engineers across Cisco’s global sites to quickly deliver software solutions

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed C# server-side scripts for an airspace management system to dynamically render floating 3-D shapes onto Google Earth
• Worked on-site with the customer along side contractors from several companies in a Scrum/Agile environment while completing projects in 2-week sprints
• Performed quality and stress testing on existing customer software
• Utilized Git revision control tools while coding in C#, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS

company.name: Dynetics, Inc. – Unmanned Systems & Aerodynamics Department

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed an Xbox 360 Kinect game using the Unreal Engine that placed people in a one-on-one game of “human pong” where the players used their bodies to hit an anti-gravity ball past the other player’s side for points
• Contributed to a proof-of-concept iPhone app commissioned by a national retail company to help their regional managers track the activities that were happening across the stores within their respective district
• Utilized languages such as C#, Objective-C, UnrealScript, and Java
• Created test plan documentation for web and iPhone applications
• Took part in the completion of a Request for Proposal (RFP) for a multi-billion dollar company

positions.title: Study Expert (Tutor) in Mathematics
positions.description:
• Tutored over 100 students in subjects ranging from Pre-Calculus to Calculus III
• Recorded tutorial video solutions for students to access on the Study Edge Facebook and mobile applications
• Administered video and file content on the Study Edge applications
• Answered students' posts on the mathematics pages in the Study Edge applications

volunteerExperiences.description:
DreamWakers is an edu-tech non-profit that virtually connects low-income 4th-12th grade classrooms with career role models over video calls (“flashchats”).

• Partnered with them over the years as a speaker for classrooms as well as once for the Kansas State Dept. of Education.
• 2020 Speaker of the Year award recipient

More info: dreamwakers.org
Performer for Ray of Light Theatre, a non-profit theatre company in San Francisco, CA.

organizations.name: Association of Computer Engineers (ACE)
organizations.description:
• Co-founded along with Dr. Herman Lam and a select group of students the first University of Florida student organization dedicated to computer engineering
• Trained the ACE Executive Board and mentored them through any issues they faced
• Served as a panelist in undergraduate workshops to expose students to tips on how to get internships, get involved, and structure their schedule to accomplish more in their academic careers

Website: uf-ace.com

organizations.name: Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE) Ambassadors
organizations.description:
• Served as an official representative for the UF Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering
• Conducted tours of the department to industry leaders, new faculty, and prospective Ph.D. candidates
